The '''Holodome''' was a large [[holo-hall]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Holodome was greater in size than the [[Holosseum]], a holo-hall situated on the planet [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], but was of an older design.
